title: Club Membership: tier-based student discount candidate for a recurring dues charge
content:
## Scope
This document states the other of the two candidate discount percentages that may reduce a Club Membership recurring dues charge: the member's own membership tier's student discount.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Student discount candidate percentage |
|---|---|
| Base Club Access | 0 percent |
| Student Metro Access | 15 percent |
| Off-Peak Metro Access | 0 percent |
| Metro Multi-Club Access | 0 percent |
| Premier All-Access | 0 percent |
| Black Card All-Access | 0 percent |
| Founding Legacy Access | 0 percent |

## Rule
The member's own membership tier carries this candidate percentage regardless of whether the member is also linked to any corporate wellness enrollment; it is a tier-based candidate, not a corporate-linked one.

## Points of judgement
Only a member enrolled in Student Metro Access carries a nonzero student discount candidate percentage under this basis; a member on any other tier carries 0 percent as this candidate, even where that other tier's own listing describes a comparable population.
